title: Finite etale origins under completed-coefficient open extension
statement: Let j:U→T be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], let d be an adic coefficient datum on A with ideal I [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and let K∈D(Mod(A_U)). If each positive quotient reduction K⊗ᴸ_(A_U)(A/I^(n+1))_U has a specified bounded-below etale origin [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], then each quotient reduction of j_!K, for the actual completed-coefficient extension [lem-cbc-completed-extension-zero-comparison], has a bounded-below etale origin on T. No completeness, quasi-compactness, common lower bound or compatibility of the supplied origins is assumed.

source.place: First paragraph: the reductions of j_!K are j_!K_n and carry the witnesses j_!L_n.

proof.text: Fix n and B=A/I^(n+1). The uniquely section-normalized pbcLevelConstantComparison is finiteOriginConstantIso, so the published finite-coordinate reduction is the given derived reduction followed by finiteOriginToConstant. Restriction along the coefficient isomorphism is an equivalence; composing its derived adjunction with the scalar-derived adjunction identifies the right adjoint of finite reduction with derived restriction along cbcFiniteProjection. Open restriction is exact: after the conservative additive-sheaf forgetful functor it is the cocontinuous open site pushforward. Localize the exact ordinary open adjunctions at quasi-isomorphisms. The existing cbcFiniteOpenRestriction identifies the two composites of right adjoints. The conjugate-isomorphism equivalence yields an isomorphism from completed open extension followed by finite reduction to finite reduction followed by constant-coefficient open extension.

The uniquely additive-normalized pbcAssociatedRestriction comparison, applied to the identity coefficient homomorphism and finiteScalarMap, identifies etaleOriginRealization with the finite constant realization C. Whisker with etale/pro-etale comparison and derive to identify etaleOriginComparison with HD. Extend the retained bounded-below etale antecedent L_n by exact etale open extension. Apply hJ, then constant open extension to the retained witness isomorphism, then the inverse reduction/open isomorphism from the preceding step, and finally the coefficient identification. This composite is the required origin isomorphism.

Exact etale open extension preserves the lower cohomological bound of each individual antecedent, through mapDerivedCategoryPlus. Pair this antecedent with the constructed isomorphism and repeat independently for all n. No common bound or compatibility is required. The construction uses only adjunctions and coefficient comparisons and also applies to the empty open and the zero quotient ring.

proof_origin.place: First paragraph, finite origins of open extension; C9 uses finite-coordinate right-adjoint comparison and uniqueness of left adjoints in place of the K-flat representative route.

lean.statement:
theorem cbcCompletedOpenFiniteEtaleOrigins
    {A : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    {U T : Scheme.{t}} (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (K : d.derived U)
    (W : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteEtaleOriginWitness U (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
      ((d.reduction U n).obj K)) :
    Nonempty (∀ n : ℕ, FiniteEtaleOriginWitness T (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
      ((d.reduction T n).obj ((cbcDerivedOpenShriek d j inferInstance).obj K)))
